persona: Catherine Denis blends a lifelong devotion to routine with a quiet curiosity, orchestrating each day like a well‑kept ledger, yet they habitually lose track of time when solving crossword puzzles, letting the world slip by.

While fully integrated into Dallas life, she balances these traditions with a pragmatic, disciplined approach to both her personal and professional worlds.
